# Plan-revision conflict fixture

`pre-conflict-slot-reviews.md` is a faithful opening excerpt of the real
Phase 2 Cycle 4 review artifact that preceded
[PR #4115](https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4115). It was produced on
2026-08-28, before the plan-revision conflict slot existed, so its document
shape is independent of this gate's writer and grammar.

The convergence gate must reject this legacy artifact as unverifiable: after
the review title, ordinary reviewer prose appears where the fixed writer-owned
slot is now required. The fixture is executed through the extracted workflow
gate, not through a test-local parser.
